sources.institution: All public colleges and universities that report payroll to OMES, plus state agencies
sources.system: State of Oklahoma Payroll (OMES) on data.ok.gov (CKAN)
sources.download_url: Monthly CSVs, e.g. https://data.ok.gov/dataset/ca31c294-6084-4bf2-a466-ab11356bd0dc/resource/55dd61f7-a7d5-4a6b-a3ab-fcfab6110933/download/payroll_public_202607.csv ; API: https://data.ok.gov/api/3/action/datastore_search?resource_id=<id> and datastore_search_sql (both work anonymously); dataset list: https://data.ok.gov/api/3/action/package_search?q=payroll
sources.coverage_years: 2010 (Q3) through FY2027 to date (July 2026); calendar-year datasets 2010-2020, fiscal-year datasets FY2021-FY2027
sources.institutions_covered: Verified in the July 2026 file: University of Oklahoma, OU Health Sciences Center, Oklahoma State University, UCO, NSU, Cameron, East Central, SE and SW Oklahoma State, Northwestern OSU, Panhandle State, Langston, Rogers State, USAO, OCCC, Tulsa CC, Rose State, Seminole State, Carl Albert, Connors, Eastern OSC, Redlands CC, Murray State, NEO A&M, Northern Oklahoma College, Western Oklahoma SC, State Regents, RUSO, OSSM, University Center at Ponca City, CareerTech. 147 agencies in total.
sources.format: CSV (monthly files) + CKAN Datastore API (JSON, SQL)
sources.update_frequency: monthly (after the 15th of the following month)
sources.size: about 19-27 MB per monthly CSV; about 174,000 rows in the July 2026 file; FY2026 has 13 monthly files
sources.notes: Best source for OK. Caveats: NO job title or department; the name is last name plus initials only; rows are payment lines by account/pay type, so annual pay per person has to be summed and the person reconstructed from agency + last name + initials, which is ambiguous for common names. Amounts include overtime/longevity/terminal pay and exclude employer FICA/retirement. Early years (2010-2020) are quarterly CSVs. One agency is misspelled ('ROSE STATE COLEGE').

sources.institution: Oklahoma state employees incl. OU, OSU, OUHSC
sources.coverage_years: multiple years (805,265 salary records per search snippet)
sources.blocker: Anti-bot 'Client Challenge' (HTTP 403) on automated requests; derived from the same OMES data, so it adds little.
sources.notes: Not needed given the OMES CKAN source.

sources.institutions_covered: colleges and universities reporting to OMES
sources.notes: Host no longer resolves (DNS ENOTFOUND). It was built from OMES payroll data. Stale/offline.

private_extra: None found; University of Tulsa, Oklahoma City University, ORU, OBU and others publish only IRS 990 data.
gaps: No job titles or departments in the official payroll data; a title roster would need university HR sources or records requests (OU and OSU do not appear to post salary lists). Branch campuses (OSU-Tulsa, OSU-OKC, OSU-IT Okmulgee, OU-Tulsa) appear to be rolled into parent agency numbers rather than broken out; not verified per campus. Technology center districts (CareerTech local districts) are not in the state payroll.
notes: Verified fields, row count and higher-ed agency list with the CKAN datastore_search and datastore_search_sql APIs (small aggregate queries only, no bulk download). Rated A despite missing titles because it is bulk, official, multi-year and API-accessible.
